title: Critical Sobolev Inequalities and Extremals for a Partially Fractional Grushin Operator
summary: We study the partially fractional Grushin-type operator \begin{equation} \mathcal L_{α,β}u=(-Δ_x)^αu-(1+β)^2|x|^{2β}Δ_y u, \qquad (x,y)\in\mathbb{R}^n\times\mathbb{R}^m,\quad 0 0$ the weight $|x|^{2β}$ destroys translation invariance in $x$, and we show that concentration is confined to the degenerate hyperplane $ Σ= \{(0,y):y\in\mathbb{R}^m\}$; this localization yields the existence of extremals for the sharp constant $S_{α,β}(n,m)$.
